title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1982-04-05
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->
source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 (With Bass EQ) -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M/Maxell DXLIIS/Dolby B) D

ai_review.summary: A solid Spring ’82 Spectrum show captured on a well‑balanced audience tape, highlighted by a fiery Bertha > Playin’ > Ship of Fools sequence and a standout Friend of the Devil.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) capture that most listeners find surprisingly clear and immersive, though it isn’t high‑resolution studio quality. The performance itself is generally solid – first‑set classics like Althea and Deep Elem flow well, while the second set delivers a memorable Bertha > Playin’ > Ship of Fools jam and an excellent Friend of the Devil, despite a few rough spots in the deep‑element segment. Energy runs medium‑high overall, with a few reviewers noting a weaker start to the second set.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and praise both the show and the audience recording; a few note minor flaws in the tape and second‑set flow, pulling the average down to a solid but not outstanding rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Brilliant and immersive audience recording according to several reviewers; noted as not high‑resolution but the best available source, with minor issues like a fast patch on Jack Straw and occasional missing seconds in the second set.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set rolls smoothly with classics; second set kicks off strong with Bertha and a long jam into Drums, though the beginning of the set feels a bit uneven for some listeners.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His voice is praised as 'good' and he 'fires on eight cylinders'; guitar work noted as solid throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: No direct comments beyond his role in the Jer/Phil switch before the drums jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby's slide practice highlighted; his contributions to the jams are mentioned positively.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboards) is noted for staying in the long jam and keeping the energy up during the extended Drums section.
band_member_comments.Drums: Unique post‑Ship jam into Drums receives praise; drummers are described as steering the excursion skillfully.
